fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld -- a flat ld+json array, not a Yoast @graph, and unlike other Nigerian outlets in this portfolio it carries a complete articleBody directly) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, dailypost.ng/feed/) carry title/link-style fields.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-jsonld, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind (not_found, not_article, http_<code>, blocked_or_transient).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the ld+json NewsArticle node.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/summary, from the ld+json NewsArticle node (falls back to <meta name="description"> if ever missing).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, from the ld+json NewsArticle node's own articleBody field (confirmed complete, not truncated).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name, from the ld+json NewsArticle author field (a single inline Person object on this site).

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: Editor name, from the ld+json NewsArticle editor field (often the same person as author on this site).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Publisher/site name ("Daily Post Nigeria"), from the ld+json NewsArticle node's inline publisher Organization object (falls back to <meta property="og:site_name"> if that field is ever missing).

articleSection.title: Article section
articleSection.description: Section/category, from the ld+json NewsArticle node (a plain string, e.g. "News", "Sport").

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keyword tags from the ld+json NewsArticle node -- raw passthrough, may include blank/whitespace-padded entries.

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead image URL from the ld+json NewsArticle node's thumbnailUrl field.

image.title: Image
image.description: Raw passthrough of the ld+json NewsArticle node's image field -- a list of ImageObject entries with url/width/height.

timeRequired.title: Time required
timeRequired.description: Upstream-computed estimated reading time, ISO 8601 duration (e.g. "PT28S"), from ld+json.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item's <link>.

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: Publish date from the RSS item's <pubDate>.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Section/tag categories from the RSS item's <category> tags (latest mode only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: WordPress post GUID from the RSS item (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
